_comment: Pre-Moon Lord summoner for tModLoader (Terraria 1.4.4 content; tModLoader has no 1.4.5 port yet, so 1.4.5 items/changes don't apply). Applied by `harness.py --setup-character` (mod command equip_loadout). Each item is an internal ItemID name, a numeric item id, or a list of alternatives tried in order; ids are from terraria.wiki.gg. Accessory order is priority: 5 usable in a Normal world, 6 in Expert (Demon Heart slot), 7 in Master. Terraprisma (slot 1) is the summon cast at setup (user's choice, 2026-10-08); the Stardust Dragon Staff stays in slot 0 as a spare. Offensive swap (user, 2026-10-09): Spooky armour replaces Hallowed (summon), Hercules Beetle and Berserker's Glove replace Ankh Shield and Worm Scarf; no debuff immunity or damage reduction from those two any more. 2026-10-09 evening: Worm Scarf back in place of Berserker's Glove (live: Spooky + offensive accessories doubled minion damage but roughly doubled damage taken). Arena for a LARGE world (user, 2026-10-09): rows 24 tiles apart (was 12) so falls keep their speed, 12 rows = 288 tiles tall, furniture every 2nd row to stay in buff range; the leash also stops at the mod's full-gravity line. Large world live (2026-10-09 17:50, human logs): gravity is full up to ~245 tiles above the arena floor and fades above, so the top 1-2 rows are in low gravity; max_rise_tiles 240 keeps scripted/fly below that.

nurse._comment: Nurse healing protocol (harness --nurse; house: harness --build-nurse-house). User design 2026-10-11.
